details:
ASTRA CARE – AI-Powered Astronaut Health and Wellness Monitoring Prototype

ASTRA CARE is an AI-powered web application designed to support astronaut health and wellbeing during space missions. It brings health monitoring, nutrition tracking, mental wellness support, data visualization, and space-biology research into one platform.

The website allows users to record health information such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, oxygen saturation, sleep, and mood. Its AI-powered feature can analyze submitted information and generate an educational health summary with observations and general precautions. The Nutrition & Wellness section supports meal scheduling, food and hydration logging, reminders, and progress tracking. Weekly and monthly analytics help users understand recorded health trends, while the Mental Wellness section encourages healthy routines.

ASTRA CARE also includes a NASA OSDR Research Explorer that allows users to search historical space-biology datasets using filters such as organism, mission factors, and data type.

The project uses NASA's Open Science Data Repository as a scientific resource. It was developed as a responsive web application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Google AI Studio/Gemini AI, and supporting web technologies.

The main goal is to make astronaut wellness information easier to record, understand, and review, potentially supporting better awareness of health and wellbeing during space missions.

ASTRA CARE is an independent educational prototype, not an official NASA product or a medical device.
